About Al-Shorouk

An industrial supplier built for project requirements.

Headquartered in Downtown Cairo, Al-Shorouk Trading & Supplies has operated in the Egyptian market for over 20 years and has contributed to more than 100 industrial and residential projects nationwide.

We are an authorized distributor for leading brands in our field, supporting procurement teams with competitive pricing, responsive supply, warranties and after-sales service.
